id: \bI wanted to show you something, but now isn't the best time.
en: \bI wanted to show you something, but now isn't the best time.
it: \bVolevo mostrarti una cosa, ma non è il momento migliore.

id: \bI learned this to help out, but no one wants it.
en: \bI learned this to help out, but no one wants it.
it: \bL'ho imparata per rendermi utile, ma nessuno la vuole.
\bVuoi imparare Comete?
\bTorna a trovarci!

id: \bWhat do we do? The data can't fall into the wrong hands.
en: \bWhat do we do? The data can't fall into the wrong hands.
it: \bChe facciamo? I dati non devono finire nelle mani sbagliate.

id: \bHere at the institute we study the different effects of weather. We have even found a Pokémon that focuses around it.
en: \bHere at the institute we study the different effects of weather. We have even found a Pokémon that focuses around it.
it: \bQui all'istituto studiamo i diversi effetti del tempo atmosferico. Abbiamo persino trovato un Pokémon legato proprio a quello.
\bChe ci fai qui dentro?
\bCome ho fatto a perdere?
\bOh, no.

id: \bI finally did it! I made a rock that extends the effects of Rain. Please take it and spread the word.
en: \bI finally did it! I made a rock that extends the effects of Rain. Please take it and spread the word.
it: \bCe l'ho fatta, finalmente! Ho creato una roccia che prolunga gli effetti della pioggia. Prendila e spargi la voce.

id: \bCome back later. I may have made more.
en: \bCome back later. I may have made more.
it: \bTorna più tardi. Potrei averne fatte altre.
\bTogliti di mezzo.

id: \rWhat are you doing? Did you scare them away?
en: \rWhat are you doing? Did you scare them away?
it: \rChe stai facendo? Li hai fatti scappare?

id: \bWhat am I doing? I already have the data chip. There's no need for the disguise anymore.
en: \bWhat am I doing? I already have the data chip.  There's no need for the disguise anymore.
it: \bChe sto facendo? Ho già il chip dei dati.  Il travestimento non serve più.
\bÈ ora di tornare alla base. Ci vediamo.
\bGrazie mille.

id: \bThank you for your help. How would you like to train a Castform? It changes based on the weather.
en: \bThank you for your help. How would you like to train a Castform? It changes based on the weather.
it: \bGrazie per il tuo aiuto. Che ne diresti di allenare un Castform? Cambia in base al tempo atmosferico.
\bPeccato. Potrebbe esserti molto utile.
\bTrattalo bene.

id: \rShelly: Are you trying to save the Castform? Too bad, we need the data chip its carrying.
en: \rShelly: Are you trying to save the Castform? Too bad, we need the data chip its carrying.
it: \rAda: Stai cercando di salvare i Castform? Peccato, ci serve il chip dei dati che si portano dietro.

id: \rShelly: You win this round. Grunts, get ready to retreat.
en: \rShelly: You win this round. Grunts, get ready to retreat.
it: \rAda: Questo round l'hai vinto tu. Reclute, preparatevi alla ritirata.
